facts.note: When the Grand Temple bell struck nine, Aurèle had everyone take out watches and inspected them; Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell. Same timepiece and relation.

Piquet with Odile (taken as the sheet's 'Madame', since the transcript never says otherwise) in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat. Odile began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. All parts present and in order.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after Vauthier sat down again.
